Every Sunday, Lucy spends the afternoon with her babysitter, Kaylen. Lucy loves Kaylen because Kaylen always takes Lucy on fun and exciting adventures. Today, Kaylen was holding a magnifying glass in one hand and a notebook in the other.

slides.text: “Are you ready to go on an adventure?” Kaylen asked Lucy. “Yes!” Lucy cried. “On today’s adventure, we are going to become nature explorers,” explained Kaylen, “our mission is to discover new creatures.” Kaylen led Lucy into the backyard and helped her use the magnifying glass to look closely at the plants in the garden.
